reviews.comment: Head is a very nice prof, but his lectures could be monotonous if not locked in. Tip: take the quizzes while in lecture to catch what he says- often not in text. Exams not bad if you do ch Q's. Semester-long group 'audit' was a lot of work and sometimes frustrating to coordinate with partners, but it was a good experience to see the audit process.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Head is a nice professor who cares about internal auditing and makes sure we learn the proper information. He tells us what will be on the test so we are properly prepared. Group project for the class is one of worst things ever, but he grades more on effort that correct answers. His lectures can be long and dull at times but he's a nice professor.

Prof Head cares a lot about the subject, and his students. His lectures can be hard to follow, but if you show up and pay attention, it's manageable. If you attend class, read the textbook, and do the quizzes and practice exams, this class is fairly easy to get an A in. Just make sure to keep up with the material and read the textbook.

If you're taking prof head just know that he yaps a lot and lowkey goes on tangents. Check howdy for Knoops class schedule. Attendance not mandatory so if you have time, just go to knoops classes instead. Hes a really nice guy, its just a super hard class and knoop has some magic in her teaching skills that makes it make sense.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is a super nice guy and clearly knows about his field, but his lectures are EXTREMELY HARD to follow. He often goes on long tangents in his lectures and will use confusing terminology whilst explaining concepts that are already difficult. The handwriting is also hard to read.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the easiest classes at Mays by far, except there is lots of busy work especially for a one hour credit course. There is a final essay with a min. 2000 word count. Do not spend too much time on it. QUALITY DOES NOT MATTER. All he cares about is that the final word count is over 2000. Class was interesting but I still skipped most times.

ACCT 229 is a difficult class, but Professor Head makes it as easy as possible. He explains the material very clearly and makes sure that you understand everything. He is very accessible for office hours and is extremely helpful if you need anything. Very professional man with real-life experience. I would highly recommend him for ACCT 229.

I truly wish I wouldn't have taken this class if I knew how bad of a teacher Mr. Head was. He is genuinely the worst teacher I have ever had in my entire life. He goes on rants about the most random things. DO NOT TAKE HIM UNLESS YOU WANT TO FEEL STRESSED 24/7.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He rambles on and on during lectures and doesn't actually teach anything about the class. Spends multiple days on something that should be taught in 1 day. I've learned more from the textbook than I could learn from 3 of his lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: FINC 350 is the easiest class you will take at Mays.

He is such a nice guy. You can tell he cares about the students and is very kind. His lectures are confusing, and he rambles on for long periods of time. He discusses definitions and formulas, and then you have to find a way to apply what he taught to the actual problems. 90% of your grade is based on exams. I had to Q drop :( The class is SO hard.

THIS CLASS IS HARD, but I went to MaysTutors for this class and it really helped out. They teach you how to succeed in the class and help with test taking strategies. Honestly, do MaysTutors and you will get a A. So much better than SI and Tutor John. Also they offer cash incentives for those that get As on their test.

Professor Head is a very knowledgeable professsor, but is sometimes hard to follow. He often goes on long tangents during lecture, so it can be hard to understand the material at times. However, you need to go to class to do well. My biggest recommendation is to attend as many SI sessions as you can; they are the reason I'm ending with an A.

Professor Head is a great teacher, as long as you pay attention. I got a little too confident and started skipping class causing my grade to drop. Accounting is a hard class, but Professor Head made it somewhat easier to understand. My best advice is to seek help and not be afraid to ask for help.

He seems like a really nice guy. However, he is not the best at explaining the material... he is almost too smart for his own good. Prepare yourself to learn majority of the information through yourself. Drops lowest 5 quizzes and the homework allows you to check the answers before submitting. Nice guy, hard class.

Acct 229 is possibly the hardest classes offered at Mays. that being said professor Head does his best to make it understandable and clear. I had issues staying awake in class, and he often rambles for long periods. Professor Head does his best but I'd recommend taking this class with Knoop, but this class is doable with Head.

Nice guy, but terrible prof. Very knowledgeable but goes on long tangents about nothing. Worked my ass off to scrape by with an A, and had to read the textbook because lectures were too confusing. He has no idea how to lecture clearly and chronologically. try for any other 229 prof if you can

Professor Head's lectures are boring and impossible to follow. The main reason I got an A in this class is because I watched Professor Knoop's review videos and redid all the quizzes and SI session worksheets. He is a very sweet man but I just don't recommend him as a professor.
Tests make the grade. Homework and quizzes are easy points. Good teacher and gives good exam feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you were to listen to me, I would advise staying away from taking Michael Head unless you want to teach yourself about accounting. Not only was it hard, but the online formatting did not help. Find yourself a professor who prepares you for the test. That's the real kicker of this whole accounting thing considering there a huge factor for grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Head is a good guy, but his class has been one of the most difficult classes I've ever taken at A&M. Having this class online was brutal, my life had revolved around trying to pass the class and sitting 15+ hours a day at my computer trying to comprehend. The class is achievable, but you must put in the work and use all your resources.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Head was an amazing professor. Class was in person, but morphed to a online class due to the pandemic. Ultimately, ACCT229 is a difficult class, but Mr. Head is extremely knowledgeable in the field. He explains the material well and is great at answering questions. Lectures can be a tad boring at times, but they are very helpful and crucial.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: ACCT 229 was challenging since 90% of your grade is based on 4 exams. SI sessions are really helpful for this class so take advantage of them. Study quizzes and all supplemental materials available to prepare for the exams. The help desk is also helpful if you need help with online quizzes. Awesome professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The tests are extremely difficult and require extensive preparation to pass. There is an abundance of study resources provided (help desk, practice problems, study guides), and utilizing all of them is essential to doing well. There is a nice grade cushion in the form of homework and quizzes, plus he curves final grades. Work hard and youll pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HEAD! I ended up going to a better professor's class after I bombed the first test, and even then I was hopelessly lost because I was stuck with him for the basics. I'm one of the 30%+ that has to Q-drop. Not happy. He's really a good guy, but a horrible teacher. Literally choose anyone else before registering for his class.

Hands down the hardest class i have taken so far. But also hands down my favorite professor ive ever had. This man really wants his students to succeed, but its honestly up to you to put in the work. Practice practice practice. The exams are very hard. Put in alot of work, and youll for sure get a B. For the A, plan on giving up your social life
Lectures are really hard to follow
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: wish i had listened when literally everyone said not to take acct 229 with him :/ he's a super nice guy but really doesn't know how to effectively teach the material. boring lectures and HARD tests (most people don't finish them). if you get stuck with him go to tutor john and knoop's review session !!!
hardest class i've ever taken in my entire life. tests are ridiculously hard, last semester 40% of his students made a C or d and 30% q dropped if that tells you anything.

Teaching is not Professor Head's first profession, and that is easy to tell. He has a very advanced knowledge of accounting, but his lectures are ineffective. His lectures are very confusing, he seems to ramble on and on in a very monotonous voice. It is easy to get lost in class. That being said, he clearly cares about his students.

Professor Head seems to be a likable guy but his lectures are extremely long and confusing. If you asked for him to clarify, he tried to cover so many scenarios that you got even more confused. I went to the help desk every week and any other tutoring available and still only made a C in the class. There is no dependable curve.

Honestly, I loved Professor Head as a person; he was caring about his students and really wanted them to succeed in the course. He was accessible out of class and even gave his personal cell number to his students for convenience. He teaches because he truly wants to (not because of a need). Loved him but could do more examples in class. Great guy!
Professor Head is a great teacher, but the class itself is difficult. He is super accessible outside of class so if you are really struggling I would recommend going to him for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Head is a fantastic professor. He cares for his students, and legitimately wants you to understand the material. Though it can tend to be boring at times, Head sincerely tries to make accounting 229 as engaging as possible. Accounting is just "ok" to me, but i enjoyed his class. You have to work for an A, but doable. GO TO REVIEW SESSIONS
He kind of drones on about the same subject, however he is very good at explaining things students don't get. He will work with you on things, especially if something messes up techonologically.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Super nice and always super willing to help. However, the lectures tend to drag on and his voice a bit of a drony quality which makes it a little difficult to pay attention. The quizzes aren't too bad but the exams are. Do every practice problem you can find and you'll get a B. Maybe an A if you work extra hard. GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: The class isn't too hard if you do the homework. Prof. Head really likes accounting, but his lectures are boring and drag on, the examples are helpful though. Do the supplemental practice problems he puts on ecampus before the test and go to the reviews. If you do that youll get a B at the very least, probably an A. Common exams, EC, easy quizes
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great guy! Really cares and is always available to help! He gives you all of his lectures, powerpoint, practice quizzes and practice problems all you have to do is put in the work! Take advantage of office hours and the help desk. His lectures are pretty boring but it is accounting so it's kind of hard to make it interesting so... I liked him tho

Professor Head is the type of guy that teaches not because he needs to but because he wants to. He really does care about his students and wants you to succeed. That being said, his lectures are not very helpful and they do tend to drag on. Do as many practice problems as possible and go to test reviews.

Professor Head is a very nice guy who really cares about his students. He does have a tendency (which he will admit) to talk around a question without effectively answering it. His lectures are rather boring and unhelpful, so the best way to learn the material is to do the practice problems posted online on your own and review with him after class.

DO NOT TAKE MICHAEL HEAD IF YOU CAN AVOID IT. Not only is he the worst accounting 229 professor in the department, he misled us all semester long into thinking that he was going to give us a huge curve when the curve ended up only being 2 points. Nice guy, but not a good teacher at all. You will be much better off with Knoop or Barrett trust me.
